assumptions.text: Expert routing is assumed perfectly balanced: every one of the 2 expert-parallel ranks receives exactly the mean token load. Real routing is skewed, and under synchronous EP the layer's wall clock is the busiest rank's, so the MoE step times and the all-to-all here are a lower bound rather than an estimate. Set `ep_load_factor` to the max/mean expert load from a routing trace to price it (the busiest rank's load follows from it and the experts each rank holds); the model carries no default for it, because a number nobody measured would read like one somebody did.
